title: Automated replenishment replacing manual reorder spreadsheets
current_state: Store leads manually calculate reorder points in spreadsheets and email POs weekly.
future_state: ERP auto-generates replenishment suggestions from demand signals; leads manage exceptions.
process_change: Shift from manual weekly reorder calculation to system-driven exception management.

Store Leads.desc: Move from calculating orders to triaging system exceptions.

change_considerations: Leads worry the system won't account for local events.
mitigation: Training (exception workflow), Communication (benefit narrative), Coaching (first two cycles).
benefit_at_risk: Stockout reduction depends on leads trusting the suggestions.
access_constraints: Store leads have limited desk time; deliver in-aisle on tablets.

title: Open-to-buy financial planning introduced as net-new capability
current_state: No enterprise open-to-buy process; buyers plan by instinct in Excel.
future_state: Buyers operate an open-to-buy discipline in the ERP planning module.
process_change: Introduce an enterprise open-to-buy planning discipline.
change_considerations: Buyers have never operated a formal OTB process.
benefit_at_risk: Markdown avoidance is unrealized until buyers adopt OTB.
access_constraints: Classroom time hard to schedule during buying season.
